hero.title: Capable people make better statistics.
hero.sub: SAMARTH AI is a student prototype that helps India's statistical workforce see their skills, close their gaps and keep learning.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.statement: Every official in the statistical system should be able to see where their skills stand, what to learn next and how far they have come, and every institution should be able to see the same, securely and fairly.

problem.title: The problem we picked
body: Officials need continuous upskilling, but the large iGOT Karmayogi catalogue does not tell them what fits their role. There is no intelligent skill-gap assessment for official statistics, trainers lack a fast way to create assessments, and administrators lack workforce-level visibility.

items.title: Explainable
items.body: Every recommendation and question shows its reason or source.

items.title: Numbers by code, language by AI
items.body: Levels and gaps come from tested formulas. AI drafts, extracts and ranks inside validated limits.

items.title: People decide
items.body: Trainers approve questions. Administrators can override.

items.title: Privacy by design
items.body: Minimum data, and no personal data sent to the AI model.

items.title: Honest about limits
items.body: We label what is simulated or planned.

items.title: Accessible and bilingual
items.body: Keyboard friendly, WCAG 2.2 AA target, English and Hindi.

ladder.title: The proficiency ladder
ladder.intro: Every competency is rated on six levels, from 0 to 5.

levels.name: None
levels.summary: No exposure to the competency yet.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.summary: Knows the terms and the purpose, and needs guidance.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.summary: Handles complex cases and guides others.

roadmap.title: Project timeline
roadmap.intro: Weeks are counted from project kickoff. Calendar dates are still to be set by the team.

phases.title: Setup
phases.body: Stack running, contracts agreed, framework draft.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.body: Login and roles, profile, framework, iGOT mock, UI shell.

phases.title: Core AI
phases.body: Gap analysis, recommendations, content pipeline, quiz generation with review.

phases.title: Loop closure and dashboards
phases.body: Quiz attempts, evidence to score to recommendation, admin analytics, tutor.

phases.title: Security and polish
phases.body: Audit chain, anchoring, mock SSO, Hindi, labs, hardening.

phases.title: Test, deploy, present
phases.body: Stable demo URL, evaluation numbers, rehearsals.

tech.title: Technology
tech.intro: Modular, adapter-based architecture: the AI model, iGOT, email, storage and ledger sit behind swappable adapters.

team.title: The team
team.intro: Six people, six areas of ownership.

disclaimer.title: Prototype disclaimer
disclaimer.body: SAMARTH AI is a student prototype built in response to Smart India Hackathon problem statement SIH26101 (MoSPI). It is not an official Government of India website or service, and it is not endorsed by or affiliated with MoSPI, NSSTA, iGOT Karmayogi or the Government of India. Courses, integrations and some figures are simulated for demonstration.
